What makes Beacon different

Food we'd feed
our own family.

Inspired by our travels across America and around the world — and by how we feed our own kids at home.

Hey there

"We're the Thompsons, originally from Nashville and now happily living in Blythewood. We wanted to create a place where people could slow down, connect, and enjoy really good coffee and food made with care."

Landon & Jordan Thompson, owners

No seed oils

No seed oils, artificial flavors, food dyes or preservatives in our food or drinks.

Local sourdough

English muffins and focaccia baked by Our Daily Bread in downtown Columbia.

Plant-lined cups

To-go cups are lined with corn or sugar PLA — not plastic.

Baked in house

Pastries made with whole, clean ingredients and imported Italian flour.

What happens after someone books

  • Instant confirmation email with directions and parking
  • Reminder the day before, so fewer no-shows
  • Seat limits enforced automatically, with a waitlist when full

  • Every guest joins the Beacon email list (with permission)

Jordan Mikal Artistry · Photography & Art

Moments captured.
Beauty created.

“My name is Jordan, and I believe I was born to create.”

Beacon's co-owner has photographed weddings and families since 2006 — first as Landon Jacob Photography with Landon, now as Jordan Mikal Photography. Her images have appeared in magazines and on several covers. Since 2018 she has also painted professionally, and she leads every workshop at Beacon.
